remarks: Rare two bedroom townhouse in the Cove area for rent!! Recently renovated unit with so much love. Unit has hardwood floors throughout, large E-I-K, double closet in larger bedroom, living room with sliders to brand new patio area and lower level used as den office space. Laundry area with stackable washer and dryer. Conveniently located walking distance to Beach, Parks and Public Transportation.
